faqs.question: Can foreign nationals buy Trump Cliff Villas in Oman?
faqs.answer: Yes. Oman offers 100% freehold ownership for all nationalities on qualifying Integrated Tourism Complex (ITC) properties. Buyers should confirm specific eligibility conditions with DarGlobal or their legal advisor.
